experience.role: Mid Software Engineer (Full-Stack, DevOps, Cloud Architect)
highlights: Architected migration from PM2 to multi-node Kubernetes with blue-green deployments, 40% faster deploys, 99% uptime.
Modernized runtime ecosystem (Node.js 12→22, TypeScript, GraphQL, gRPC, Redis, Elastic, AWS SDK v2→v3).
Re-engineered CI/CD pipelines with K8s runners, delta testing, DevSecOps; halved pipeline test time.
Led payments modernization (SOAP→REST), reducing error rates by 80%, streamlined workflows.
Optimized billing and document systems with S3 + Step Functions, 15% faster processing, 60% cost savings.
Integrated AWS Textract OCR + Elasticsearch pipelines, 60% faster onboarding, better search.
Standardized infra with Pulumi IaC; hybrid connectivity (on-prem, OCI, AWS).
Upgraded Superset & Airflow; deployed to Kubernetes with LDAP integration.
Re-architected support platform to serverless Next.js SSR on AWS (Lambdas, CloudFront, S3).
Introduced OpenTelemetry tracing + ELK stack for observability.
Responsive animated bank landing page with HTML/CSS/SwiperJS/Bootstrap/jQuery.
Geo-enabled public services report app: Flutter + Django REST + OpenStreetMap.
Cross-platform language learning app with Musixmatch-like features; Firebase backend.
Loan approval Angular web app with OAuth, PDF upload, draft mgmt, RBAC; Firebase backend.
Enhanced warehouse ordering system (Django, SQLite, Ajax, jQuery).
Implemented OpenTelemetry + ELK stack for observability.
Architected tennis match prediction platform with Angular Nx frontend + FastAPI backend, Postgres, ML models (Keras, scikit-learn, XGBoost, Random Forest).
Developed client websites with Next.js, Tailwind, Vercel, Bun, CircleCI, Cypress.
Created business site with Next.js, MUI, Bun, CircleCI, Cypress.

Sustained 200+ files/batch, 90% success rate, 70% less manual work.
